name: Generic cloud agent (pull-request delivered)
notes: Provider-agnostic tier-3 adapter: works with any cloud agent that delivers its result as a branch or pull request, with no vendor API and no vendor cooperation. Dispatch is out-of-band (assign an issue, click once in an IDE); everything after that is observed through git. Requires the GitHub CLI.

dispatch.note: The human or a vendor-specific adapter starts the task. This adapter is told the expected author/branch prefix and takes over from there.

poll.note: Polling interval is measured in minutes, not seconds. Cloud tasks run for minutes to hours; a tight loop only burns API quota.

busy.running_when: no pull request yet, or the pull request is still a draft
busy.note: There is no local file to watch and no two-writer hazard: the workspace is remote.

cost.note: Usually included in a plan and not itemised per task.

duration.note: Elapsed time between the dispatch event and the result event, both written to the event log.

verification.rule: The delivered branch is untrusted code. Gates run locally against the merged result before anything lands. Auto-merge is never enabled, and a check written by the same agent that wrote the code is not a gate.

brief_requirements: gates that will judge the result
explicit statement that fixture or partial evidence does not count as done
